instruction: Crisp studio photograph, full shot from a high angle. In a minimalist white studio with a seamless background, the woman in the white hooded outfit (R2) on the left lunges forward, pressing her hands against the chest of the woman in the black hooded outfit (R1) on the right. The woman in black (R1) recoils slightly, tilting her head back defensively while raising her hands. Both barefoot dancers perform this intense, coordinated movement under bright high-key studio lighting that casts soft shadows on the clean floor.
elements: R2 lunges forward and presses her hands against R1's chest
R1 recoils defensively from R2's chest contact
R1 raises her hands while tilting her head back in response to R2
R2 is the initiating pusher while R1 is the receiving defender
